name: Obsidian CLI
description: Lets the agent work with Obsidian through its official CLI.

display_description.en: Lets WorkSwarm work with your Obsidian vault through Obsidian's official CLI. Windows only. REQUIRES Obsidian 1.12.7 or later, running with your vault open. REQUIRES settings: turn on Command line interface under Settings > General, turn on Automatically update internal links under Settings > Files and links. If Obsidian is not installed at the default path, the agent will ask you for the path. Version 0.1.1.
display_description.zh: 版本 0.1.1。让 WorkSwarm 通过 Obsidian 官方命令行操作你的笔记库。仅支持 Windows。需要 Obsidian 1.12.7 或更高版本，并保持其运行、打开你的笔记库。需要开启的设置：在“设置 > 通用”中开启“命令行界面”，并在“设置 > 文件与链接”中开启“自动更新内部链接”。如果 Obsidian 未安装在默认路径，智能体会询问你它的安装路径。

default_init_input.zh: 我本地的更改同步了吗？我还剩多少存储空间？

display_description.en: Runs Obsidian CLI commands and reports failures, timeouts and open dialogs clearly.
display_description.zh: 运行 Obsidian 命令行指令，并明确报告失败、超时和打开的对话框。
